name: Mogán (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mogán (a sun, a tower, a lighthouse and waves).
history: Mogán has no officially approved flag; the municipal arms were approved by the Government of the Canary Islands by order of 17 May 1993.

features.role: Mogán arms — sun, tower, lighthouse and waves
